title: 25 Years of Punk
overview: Lou Reed narrates this Television special that takes a look back at the beginnings of the punk rock movements in New York & England, the underground punk scenes in the 70's & 80's, and the punk resurgence in the 90's. A collaboration between VH1 and Spin magazine.

file.itemTitle: D.O.A.'s Joe Keithley talks w Eric Blair his 25 years in Punk Rock 2003
